plugins.name: configuration
plugins.description: Provides configuration authoring, session and dataset management, and metadata discovery skills for sollertia-shared-assets. Includes MCP bindings for reading, writing, and validating Sollertia platform configuration and runtime data files.

plugins.name: experiment
plugins.description: Provides acquisition system setup, experiment design, system health checks, hardware interface, and runtime data management skills for sollertia-experiment. Includes MCP bindings for Zaber motor management, session preprocessing, and animal migration.

plugins.name: processing
plugins.description: Provides post-acquisition data processing pipeline orchestration skills for the Sollertia platform. Reserved for processing functionality that is being absorbed into other Sollertia libraries.
